list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: A centrosymmetric Yb(III) dimer. Each pyrrolyl-functionalized dianionic ligand bridges the metal centers through an η5-bound pyrrolyl ring at one Yb and pyrrolyl and tethered amido nitrogen donors at the other.

synthesis.procedure: Compound 2 was treated with the Yb(III) amide under dry argon using the procedure described for 4: addition in toluene, stirring at room temperature for 6 h and then at 100 °C for 24 h, followed by solvent removal, hexane extraction, concentration, and cooling to crystallize.
synthesis.temperature: Room temperature, then 100 °C; crystallization at 0 °C by the shared procedure
synthesis.time: 6 h at room temperature, then 24 h at 100 °C by the shared procedure
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Solvent evaporation, hexane extraction and cooling; dark-red crystals.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: A centrosymmetric Eu(II) dimer with lithium-supported ligands. A pyrrolyl-functionalized ligand bridges Eu centers through an η5 pyrrolyl ring at one center and pyrrolyl nitrogen and tethered oxygen donors at the other. An imino-functionalized pyrrolyl ligand also η5-binds Eu while its nitrogen donors coordinate lithium.

synthesis.procedure: The Eu(III) amide, secondary amine 2 and cyclic dimethylsiloxane were reacted under dry argon using a procedure similar to that for 4 in toluene, with heating and subsequent solvent removal and hexane extraction.
synthesis.temperature: Room temperature followed by 100 °C by the shared procedure
synthesis.time: 6 h at room temperature followed by 24 h at 100 °C by the shared procedure
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Workup followed the procedure for 4; red crystals were isolated.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: A centrosymmetric macrocycle containing six Eu(II) and six Li ions. Eight bis-imino-linked dipyrrolyl dianions bridge different metals, accompanied by two additional imino-functionalized pyrrolyl ligands.

synthesis.procedure: A toluene solution of linked diamine 3 was added to a toluene solution of the Eu(III) amide at room temperature under dry argon. The mixture was stirred at 100 °C for 24 h. Solvent was removed under reduced pressure, and the residue was extracted twice with hexane and dried under vacuum.
synthesis.temperature: Addition at room temperature; reaction at 100 °C; crystallization at 0 °C
synthesis.time: 24 h at 100 °C; crystals formed within one week at 0 °C
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Evaporation under reduced pressure, hexane extraction and vacuum drying; red X-ray-quality crystals obtained from hexane at 0 °C.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: A lithium-supported tetranuclear Dy(III) assembly with pyrrolyl-functionalized bridging ligands and two μ3-chloride-containing units. The pyrrolyl rings participate in staggered and eclipsed lithium sandwich interactions; the article describes the assembly as four-sandwiched.

synthesis.procedure: Linked diamine 3 was treated with the Dy(III) amide under dry argon by the procedure described for 9: mixing toluene solutions, stirring at 100 °C for 24 h, removing solvent, and extracting the residue with hexane.
synthesis.time: 24 h at 100 °C by the shared procedure
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Solvent evaporation and hexane extraction by the procedure for 9; colorless crystals were isolated.
